Sol claimed officer and called Gemma a killer, but Gemma's checks held up, and the town trusted her once Sol died. Gemma was killed on night four, and Luna was voted out the next day as a citizen after swinging at Gemma's results without a clear reason. Haiku, a killer, pushed Gemma's checks twice and kept demanding answers he never gave himself. The turning point came on day five, when Sonnet and Terra turned Haiku's own questions back on him until the town voted him out. The town won, with Sonnet as mayor and Terra as the doctor.
